name: [👻] Catch a Monster
desc:
Welcome to Catch a Monster!

How to Play:
⚔️ Defeat wild monsters in battle
🔮 Capture them and collect them!
⭐ Discover and collect higher-rank pets
🥚 Find rare eggs and hatch new companions

💰 Earn coins and grow your squad! 
🔥 Show off your strongest monsters! 

👍 Like the game and join our group!
